probes.description: Check all path constructions containing 'users' and 'totals' in scheduling files
probes.result: scheduling.go:692 uses paths.Workspace(wsID, 'scheduling', 'assignments', 'users', userID, 'totals') — note this is /users/{userId}/totals not /users/totals. scheduling_totals.go:50 same pattern. getWorkspaceScheduleUserTotalsRaw uses 'user-filter/totals' not 'users/totals'.
probes.finding: GOCLMCP does NOT use /scheduling/assignments/users/totals (without userId). It uses /scheduling/assignments/users/{userId}/totals (GET, for single-user capacity) and /scheduling/assignments/user-filter/totals (POST, for multi-user totals).
Spring-MVC 404 'No static resource' = path is NOT registered on live Clockify
POST also returns 404; the path does not exist at all on live Clockify

discrepancy.live_reality: Endpoint does not exist on live Clockify API (both GET and POST return 404 'No static resource')
discrepancy.goclmcp_impact: GOCLMCP does not use this path. The workspace-wide user totals functionality is served by POST /scheduling/assignments/user-filter/totals (endpoint #4, live-verified). The path /users/{userId}/totals (GET) is used for single-user capacity queries.
discrepancy.recommendation: Remove post.workspaces.scheduling.assignments.users.totals from OpenAPI spec; it is absent on live Clockify. The actual multi-user totals endpoint is post.workspaces.scheduling.assignments.user-filter.totals.

notes: LIVE-OVERRIDE: the OpenAPI spec (source: ours only) claims this endpoint exists, but live Clockify returns 404 for both GET and POST. This is not a Spring-MVC 405 (wrong method, path exists); it is a genuine 404 'No static resource' meaning the route is not registered. The correct path for workspace-wide user scheduling totals is /user-filter/totals (POST), not /users/totals. GOCLMCP correctly uses /user-filter/totals and /users/{userId}/totals — neither of which is the absent /users/totals path.
